brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE finished editorial thumbnail for the Japanese basketball website バスケまとめ. Landscape approximately 16:9, at least 1000 pixels wide, ideally 1600x900.

Design reference: the black/lime approved thumbnail B-culver-black-lime-v3.png already viewed in this conversation. Match its restrained dark charcoal #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B, ivory type, hand-drawn ink and bold dry-brush energy. Use its style only: DO NOT copy its athlete, names, score, date, shooting pose or any old text.

Subject identity reference: the official 2026-27 Seahorses Mikawa portrait of Yudai Nishida (西田優大) already viewed, from https://go-seahorses.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1789089098/files/user/team/player/2026-27/19_blue.jpg . Depict this REAL athlete, not an invented generic player. Preserve the observed elongated oval face, clean-shaven jaw, straight nose, full lips, relatively narrow dark eyes, straight dark hair with ash-brown/blond highlights swept and parted across the forehead, and athletic physique. Reinterpret him as an unmistakable hand-drawn monochrome ink illustration; never paste the photograph or make a photographic rendering.

Composition: sophisticated spacious sports editorial. On the RIGHT 40% of the canvas, show Nishida in an energetic low diagonal drive, bent knees, torso leaning forward, both anatomically correct hands gathering an orange basketball near his hip, ready to move. Include head, both arms, both hands and entire ball clearly inside the image; natural legs can extend toward the lower edge without awkward joint crops. Face large enough to show recognizable features. Plain unbranded dark jersey and shorts with ivory ink highlights; no lettering, no number, no badges, no logos. A single sweeping diagonal lime brush stroke behind the athlete and sparse ink texture imply movement. No other people, no hoop, no detailed arena.
On LEFT 58%, place a clean, carefully kerned Japanese text block. Huge thick Japanese Gothic display letters, excellent legibility and clear hierarchy, no overlap with athlete or ball. Keep all type comfortably inside a 5% safe margin. More readable than decorative.

Render EXACTLY this text, with no additions:
Top small ivory: 「バスケまとめ」
Below it modest ivory date: 「2026.11.06」
Main enormous ivory headline: 「試合結果」
Second large lime headline: 「当日のEFF」
Below in medium ivory: 「リーグ別・ポジション別TOP3」
Bottom small but clearly readable ivory footer: 「イラスト（AI生成）　イメージ」

Editorial constraints: The only article claims are the exact above date, game-results theme and daily EFF broken down by league and position. This image is a general illustrative play, NOT a reconstruction of the 11/06 game or a decisive real play. Nishida was randomly selected from the article's equally treated player list. Do not display his name, team name, individual stats, his rank, achievements, win/loss, appearance claims or jersey number. Do not imply he is overall number one. The TOP3 text describes the article's league/position tables only. Do not include individual scores or other names. No team/league/sponsor logos. No official photo pixels. Do not imitate a broadcast screenshot. Keep it a bold ink illustration.
Final output: one fully composed landscape PNG thumbnail, no mockup border, no variant grid.
